spec_match.rationale: Rules map call sites to the ClientSideDetectionType values in csd.proto; credit-card and unfamiliar-login triggers labelled off-by-default/browser-decided per features.cc; heuristics clearly separated.

interactive.rationale: Three presets, paste box, and a real same-origin fetch of any path, with line-numbered findings table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches index blurb: paste or fetch, line-by-line trigger report with advice.

edge_cases.rationale: Invalid / cross-origin path rejected with aria-invalid; fetch failures surfaced with retry advice; no-trigger case explains other check routes.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite covers the trigger surfaces this audit searches for.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless google-chrome via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment), desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch: every control clicked, live readouts changed as expected, zero console errors / page errors / failed requests, no horizontal overflow; screenshots Read. Scam sample: 4 enabled triggers; game: 3; docs: 1 (clipboard); fetching trigger-api-playground found all 6.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts audit ran with in-range line numbers and fetch success/failure.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; rose/blue/charcoal kind labels on white meet AA.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled inputs, captioned table with th scope, focusable scroll region, status summary.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Table given a 40rem min width so it scrolls inside its region on 360px instead of collapsing; page has no overflow.

openQuestions.title: Regex scan misses obfuscated calls
openQuestions.detail: Bracket access (navigator['keyboard']) or minified aliases are not matched; consider an AST pass or a runtime instrumentation mode.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Only DOM/labels were checked via headless Playwright; chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable here (project rule 7b), so the a11y tree was not inspected.

openQuestions.title: No real Enhanced Safe Browsing run
openQuestions.detail: The server-side check itself cannot be triggered or observed from a page; nobody has confirmed end-to-end on an ESB-enabled Chrome 155 desktop profile that the documented triggers start an intelligent scan.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive two column tool layout mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets usable and content within its container on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Grids use auto-fit minmax(min(100%, Nrem), 1fr); buttons min 44x44; wide content wraps or scrolls in labelled regions.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible form validation url input with live result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use :user-invalid for styling only after interaction and sync aria-invalid with an aria-describedby error message.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: input:user-invalid border, aria-invalid set on failed submit and cleared on success, error text in aria-live element referenced by aria-describedby.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Playwright: bad input produced error text and aria-invalid=true.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on narrow mobile viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Contain wide tables in a keyboard-reachable scroll region with header semantics.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Table with caption and th scope=col in a role=region tabindex=0 wrapper with overflow-x:auto.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: m2 screenshot: table scrolls inside wrapper, page scrollWidth 360.
